hooks.command: jq 'if (.prompt // "" | contains("<github-webhook-activity>")) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "UserPromptSubmit", additionalContext: "Before acting on this webhook event: fetch the current state of the referenced GitHub object (PR comment, review, issue, run, commit) before reasoning. Webhooks lag — the underlying state may have already changed (comment edited, CI run finished, review dismissed, PR merged). Reconcile against live state, then decide. Use the GitHub MCP tools (mcp__github__*) when present, otherwise gh. For surfaces neither exposes (branch protection, rulesets), dispatch .github/workflows/gh-api.yml and read the response back from the job log."}} else empty end'
